Remark
[Alternative exclusion of the product case (Remark 32.9)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0228 ↗ lem:chow-iv-limit-nonnegative-curvature-criterion 1. ch32:32.9\group Positive and Zero Cases

The $S^2\times \mathbb R$ quotient can alternatively be excluded by applying Perelman's no-local-collapsing theorem to the eternal limit as $t\to -\infty $.
